UPN Kenosha Elevator Out of Service
The Kenosha elevator is out of service. Customers can use Zion or Winthrop Harbor as alternate boarding stations.

Beginning May 9, the 115th Street Morgan Park Station Reconstruction

Beginning May 9, 2025, the 115th Street Morgan Park Station will be temporarily inaccessible to ADA users due to station reconstruction. Full site construction is expected to continue through Spring 2026. An accessible alternative is the 111th Street Morgan Park Station. Metra will provide updates once accessibility is restored.

On April 26 - Metra Electric Trains Will Terminate and Originate From 18th Street
On Sunday, April 26, Metra Electric trains will terminate and originate from 18th Street Station due to station construction. Visit metra.com/MEelevators.com for real-time information.

Before you travel, please check our ADA Trip Planner Website for the latest real-time updates on elevator availability and ongoing construction status. Visit metra.com/MEelevators.com for real-time information.

The 95th St/Chicago State University station will close March 3, 2025 - Station Rehab and Expansion Project

On Monday, March 3, the 95th st/Chicago State University station will close for approximately 2 years to undergo a rehabilitation and expansion project. During this time passengers should use 91st street and 103rd st/Rosemoor stations as alternates. Updates will be provided.

MD-N Grayslake Station Construction

Beginning Monday, March 16, the east half of platform 1 (north platform) and the east stairway will be closed for continued rehab until the end of April. Passengers must use the west half of platform 1 to board trains. Updates will be provided.

UPW Kedzie Station Construction
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.
